import pytest
from payvane.schema import validate_payload, tokenize_pan, SchemaConfigError
from payvane import build_schema


def test_tokenize_pan_is_stable_for_tenant():
    assert tokenize_pan("4111111111111111", tenant="acme") == "tok_9c41e0a7b2d6f3"


def test_valid_nested_card_payload_passes():
    schema = build_schema([
        {"path": "billing.card.pan", "rules": ["required", "pan_length", "luhn", "bin_allowed"]},
        {"path": "billing.card.exp", "rules": ["required", "exp_future"]},
        {"path": "customer.address.postal_code", "rules": ["postal_code_us"]},
    ], bin_allowlist=["411111", "555555"])
    payload = {
        "billing": {"card": {"pan": "4111 1111 1111 1111", "exp": "12/31"}},
        "customer": {"address": {"postal_code": "94105"}},
    }
    result = validate_payload(schema, payload, now="2026-11-15")
    assert result.ok
    assert result.sanitized["billing"]["card"]["pan"] == "tok_9c41e0a7b2d6f3"


def test_bad_luhn_reports_path_and_code_without_pan():
    schema = build_schema([
        {"path": "billing.card.pan", "rules": ["required", "luhn"]},
    ])
    payload = {"billing": {"card": {"pan": "4111111111111112"}}}
    result = validate_payload(schema, payload, now="2026-11-15")
    assert not result.ok
    assert result.errors == [{"path": "billing.card.pan", "code": "LUHN_FAIL"}]
    assert "4111111111111112" not in repr(result)


def test_expired_card_fails_exp_future():
    schema = build_schema([{"path": "billing.card.exp", "rules": ["exp_future"]}])
    payload = {"billing": {"card": {"exp": "01/26"}}}
    result = validate_payload(schema, payload, now="2026-11-15")
    assert result.errors == [{"path": "billing.card.exp", "code": "EXP_PAST"}]


def test_unknown_rule_raises_at_build_time():
    with pytest.raises(SchemaConfigError):
        build_schema([{"path": "billing.card.pan", "rules": ["luhnn"]}])


def test_custom_rule_on_list_items():
    from payvane import register_rule
    register_rule("sku_format", lambda v: (v.startswith("SKU-"), "SKU_BAD"))
    schema = build_schema([{"path": "items[].sku", "rules": ["required", "sku_format"]}])
    payload = {"items": [{"sku": "SKU-1"}, {"sku": "X-2"}]}
    result = validate_payload(schema, payload, now="2026-11-15")
    assert result.errors == [{"path": "items[1].sku", "code": "SKU_BAD"}]
